deployment-bootstrap-policy-and-glm52-qu.observable_outcome: Exact zai/glm-5.2 becomes eligible only after deterministic tiered policy validation and a real Pool Worker qualification, and is the active building primary.
deployment-bootstrap-policy-and-glm52-qu.primary_invariant: Only exact qualified models route; Moonshot is fallback-only and evaluator tier is never lower than builder tier.
deployment-bootstrap-policy-and-glm52-qu.acceptance_oracle: Focused exact-ID/alias/case/wildcard registry, tier-tie, role-route, and Moonshot-primary rejection suites plus one independently verified real pinned-Pi GLM-5.2 qualification report with cost, cleanup, and immutability checks.
deployment-bootstrap-policy-and-glm52-qu.production_seam: Canonical model registry, tie-capable Worker routing/preflight configuration, and the real provider qualification boundary; probing runtime remains post-launch.
deployment-bootstrap-policy-and-glm52-qu.blast_radius: Model Routing and Evaluation, Worker preflight, launcher authentication/usage evidence, and paid qualification commands.
non_goals: GLM-5.3 registration, eligibility, or qualification (separate node).
A probing role, profile, or empirical calibration.
Modification of retained Pool Proof evidence.

exceptions.cross_domain: Exact authorization is unsafe without both deterministic Model Routing policy and executable Agent Execution qualification.
exceptions.multi_contract: Registry, capability-tier, routing, preflight, and qualification-report contracts jointly define one model's eligibility.
exceptions.multi_suite: Policy/preflight tests and real paid qualification evidence establish different halves of the same eligibility claim.

glm53-eligibility-qualification.observable_outcome: Exact zai/glm-5.3 becomes high-tier eligible after its own real Pool Worker qualification while no active role references it.
glm53-eligibility-qualification.primary_invariant: GLM-5.3 cannot route anywhere, including probing, until this node's qualification passes, and stays unreferenced by active deployment routing afterward.
glm53-eligibility-qualification.acceptance_oracle: Exact-ID/high-tier tie and unreferenced-routing tests plus one independently verified real GLM-5.3 qualification report with the same credential, cost, cleanup, and immutability checks.
glm53-eligibility-qualification.production_seam: Shared registry/preflight and qualification-report path introduced by the bootstrap policy node.
glm53-eligibility-qualification.blast_radius: Canonical model registry entries, Worker preflight configuration, and one paid qualification command/report.
non_goals: Any probing policy row or execution profile.
Active direct-task role routing changes.
Eval calibration.

exceptions.cross_domain: Eligibility requires deterministic Model Routing admission and a real Agent Execution qualification report.
exceptions.multi_contract: Reuses the registry, tier, preflight, and qualification-report contracts; no new contract is introduced.

parameterized-agent-pool-dogfood-runner.observable_outcome: One reviewed Agent Pool task runs through the public Minimal Pool Runtime using only validated manifest parameters.
parameterized-agent-pool-dogfood-runner.primary_invariant: Repository-specific behavior exists only in a bounded immutable manifest and independent verifier, never hard-coded runner policy.
parameterized-agent-pool-dogfood-runner.acceptance_oracle: A parameterized repository fixture completes red-to-green with exact commit/path/cleanup verification while hostile manifests fail before paid work.
parameterized-agent-pool-dogfood-runner.production_seam: Pool Proof Harness composition over public Minimal Pool Runtime, launcher, sandbox, persistence, and Verification interfaces.
parameterized-agent-pool-dogfood-runner.blast_radius: Harness manifest parsing, runner composition, target verifier, candidate reports, and focused tests.
non_goals: Implementing the credential-strip task.
Authorizing arbitrary repositories or commands.
Activating CRAFTS, grading, GitHub delivery, or production service operation.

exceptions.cross_domain: Harness, Agent Execution, and Verification must be exercised together to prove parameterization is real.
exceptions.multi_contract: Task and verifier manifests are separate because Worker instructions cannot define their own acceptance oracle.

credential-strip-zai-dogfood.observable_outcome: A qualified GLM-5.2 Worker produces an independently verified Agent Pool commit that strips copied provider credentials without breaking offline resolution.
credential-strip-zai-dogfood.primary_invariant: Private models.json contains only required provider metadata; authentication remains solely in private auth storage.
credential-strip-zai-dogfood.acceptance_oracle: Credential-canary red/green test plus runner-owned commit, path, isolation, resolution, and cleanup verification.
credential-strip-zai-dogfood.production_seam: Launcher provider-metadata projection exercised through the reviewed dogfood manifest.
credential-strip-zai-dogfood.blast_radius: copyProviderModels implementation, focused launcher tests, one paid dogfood attempt, and one separate report.
non_goals: Generic secret scanning or provider-token rotation.
Full CRAFTS, grading, delivery, or arbitrary-repository authorization.
Unrelated launcher or sandbox cleanup.

exceptions.multi_contract: The security fix and dogfood report are one outcome because the real run is the acceptance oracle for safe self-improvement.

direct-task-first-service.observable_outcome: An authenticated caller submits a bounded direct task and observes a durably identified real Pool Worker result without decomposition.
direct-task-first-service.primary_invariant: Direct tasks skip only decomposition/Gate 1; criteria, identity, persistence, readiness, topology-free dispatch, and mandatory Gate 2 remain authoritative.
direct-task-first-service.acceptance_oracle: HTTP/domain/store/dispatch tests and one service-level real fixture execution.
direct-task-first-service.production_seam: POST /tasks through Work Intake, Orchestration persistence/frontier, identifier-only queue, and Agent Execution composition.
direct-task-first-service.blast_radius: Work Intake HTTP/domain boundary, orchestration composition/status, runtime adapter, authentication, and tests.
non_goals: POST /specs, decomposition, Gate 1, or Graphify scheduling.
CRAFTS/grading implementation.
GitHub delivery or broad public tenancy.

exceptions.cross_domain: Intake, persistence, and execution are inseparable for the user-observable service outcome.
exceptions.multi_contract: HTTP input, accepted work, queue envelope, and attempt contracts deliberately narrow at each trust boundary.
exceptions.multi_suite: Each domain suite plus a service-level test is required to prove the vertical slice.

crafts-artifact-ledger-and-transcript-re.observable_outcome: A direct attempt accepts only schema-valid, attempt-bound, criteria-complete, append-only phase revisions linked to verified transcript objects or recorded audit_incomplete state.
crafts-artifact-ledger-and-transcript-re.primary_invariant: No phase artifact, failure context, invocation/evidence locator, or transcript metadata can be overwritten, substituted, or accepted without an existing attempt and a validated artifact contract.
crafts-artifact-ledger-and-transcript-re.acceptance_oracle: Hostile binding/schema/hash/replay rejection tests, restart-persistent ingestion/query fixture, and one public direct-attempt artifact-ingestion fixture.
crafts-artifact-ledger-and-transcript-re.production_seam: CRAFTS schema validator and artifact-object/transcript adapters at the Agent Execution → Orchestration ingestion boundary.
crafts-artifact-ledger-and-transcript-re.blast_radius: Phase-artifact validator, transcript adapter, Orchestration phase_artifacts records, and focused tests.
non_goals: Phase sequencing or the conductor lifecycle.
Evaluator choice, reruns, Tier-1/Tier-2 verdicts, retry, budget, delivery.

exceptions.cross_domain: Agent Execution produces artifacts but only Orchestration ingestion can make them durable evidence.
exceptions.multi_contract: CRAFTS artifact, security-trigger, and transcript-object contracts define acceptance at one boundary.
exceptions.multi_suite: Schema/hostile-input suites and restart/persistence suites prove validation and durability separately.

full-crafts-phase-conductor.observable_outcome: A production direct-task attempt executes the sole allowed C/security/R/A/F/T/S lifecycle with bounded repair loops and persisted handoffs.
full-crafts-phase-conductor.primary_invariant: No phase advances without the validated predecessor artifact, immutable original criteria, correct phase capabilities, and an enforceable non-lower independent evaluator pairing.
full-crafts-phase-conductor.acceptance_oracle: Full-worker fixture proving normal sequencing, one A/F and one T/F loop, security-trigger routing, capability denial, pairing preflight failure before paid work, invalid-artifact fail-closed behavior, and teardown after retention success and failure.
full-crafts-phase-conductor.production_seam: Full Worker profile/conductor, phase-scoped launcher tools, model-routing selection port, and the ledger ingestion port.
full-crafts-phase-conductor.blast_radius: Full Worker profile/skills/agents/contracts, deterministic conductor, phase grants, routing ports, and focused tests.
non_goals: Machine verdicts or deterministic test re-verification.
Empirical thresholds, budgets, or GitHub delivery.

exceptions.cross_domain: Agent Execution sequencing and Orchestration append-only persistence form one phase-gate invariant.
exceptions.multi_contract: Execution context, attempt, phase artifact, security checkpoint, and transcript-object contracts are required handoffs in one lifecycle.
exceptions.multi_suite: Worker preflight and domain behavior tests cover independent enforcement layers.

tier1-evidence-attestation.observable_outcome: Every completed CRAFTS implementation attempt receives an immutable Tier-1 pass/fail attestation bound to independently recomputed red/green evidence.
tier1-evidence-attestation.primary_invariant: Worker prose and agent-authored paths cannot make Tier 1 pass; missing red/green evidence fails closed.
tier1-evidence-attestation.acceptance_oracle: Base-red/post-green end-to-end fixture plus mutation tests for every binding: suite, commit, image, command, allowed path, criterion, environment.
tier1-evidence-attestation.production_seam: General Verification Tier-1 service consuming R/F artifacts from the Orchestration artifact ledger.
tier1-evidence-attestation.blast_radius: Verification domain Tier-1 contracts/service, evidence consumers, attestation records, and tests; sealed Pool-Proof evidence unchanged.
non_goals: Evaluator scoring or composite verdict calculation.
Calibration thresholds or delivery.

exceptions.cross_domain: A fail-closed recomputed decision is a Verification outcome that Orchestration only records.
exceptions.multi_contract: Suite, commit, environment, path, and criterion evidence contracts jointly define one attestation.
exceptions.multi_suite: Mutation/hostile-input suites and the end-to-end fixture establish recomputation and retention separately.

tier2-composite-verdict-audit.observable_outcome: Each Tier-1-complete attempt receives exactly one append-only composite verdict with a criterion-queryable audit chain using actual independent evaluator provenance and bootstrap gates.
tier2-composite-verdict-audit.primary_invariant: Composite pass is impossible unless Tier 1 passed, criteria fit is complete, no blocking finding exists, evaluator independence is proven from an actual invocation, and every audit link is valid.
tier2-composite-verdict-audit.acceptance_oracle: End-to-end graded fixture plus identical/conflicting replay and link-tamper tests for evaluator identity, tier relation, criterion, cost, artifact, suite, commit, image, and verdict link.
tier2-composite-verdict-audit.production_seam: Tier-2/composite verifier and append-only Orchestration audit ingestion/query.
tier2-composite-verdict-audit.blast_radius: Tier-2/composite contracts, verifier services, evaluator provenance records, SQLite audit records, queries, and tests.
non_goals: Empirical threshold derivation or model-policy changes.
Retries, budgets, reconciliation, or PR assembly.

exceptions.cross_domain: A verdict without durable audit persistence, or persistence without verification, cannot establish the observable outcome.
exceptions.multi_contract: Tier 1, Tier 2, composite, routing provenance, evidence locator, and audit contracts compose one verdict chain.
exceptions.multi_suite: Verification and Orchestration tests establish both validation and append-only durability.

classified-failure-retry-and-resolution.observable_outcome: Logic/integration failure counters, branch freezing, retry context, and the five governed resolutions produce one auditable lifecycle result while unrelated branches continue.
classified-failure-retry-and-resolution.primary_invariant: Only authorized resolutions change counters or frozen branches; escalation and every resolution are durable and auditable.
classified-failure-retry-and-resolution.acceptance_oracle: Property and lifecycle tests for both ceilings, downward-only overrides, branch freeze versus unrelated frontier continuation, retry reset only through authorized resolution, and auditable retry/manual-fix/cancel/force-pass/amend handling including integration re-verification classification.
classified-failure-retry-and-resolution.production_seam: Orchestration lifecycle state machine, store, and dispatch consuming the durable composite verdict and failure context.
classified-failure-retry-and-resolution.blast_radius: Orchestration lifecycle/store/dispatch, attempt numbering, failure-context projection, and focused tests.
non_goals: Spend accounting or budget admission.
Discovered-work intake.
Queue restart semantics or backup.

exceptions.cross_domain: Consumes Agent Execution failure evidence but Orchestration alone mutates lifecycle truth.
exceptions.multi_contract: Retry, classification, freeze, and resolution contracts share terminal-state semantics and cannot contradict each other.

controller-budget-guardrails.observable_outcome: Validated cumulative backend cost stops a node or new DAG dispatch at the correct ceiling without losing in-flight results.
controller-budget-guardrails.primary_invariant: Every attempted backend cost is retained with valid currency semantics and charged exactly once to the incurring attempt; restart never resets totals.
controller-budget-guardrails.acceptance_oracle: Failed-primary-plus-fallback charged once, node and DAG exhaustion paths, restart-persistent totals, and currency hostility tests.
controller-budget-guardrails.production_seam: Cost ingestion and dispatch admission at the Orchestration boundary.
controller-budget-guardrails.blast_radius: Cost-report persistence/query, dispatch admission gate, audit state, and focused tests.
non_goals: Fallback routing implementation (Agent Execution owns the fallback ledger).
Retry classification mechanics, discovery records, host backup/restore.

exceptions.cross_domain: Agent Execution produces fallback cost evidence; Orchestration alone enforces the admission gate.

discovered-work-quarantine.observable_outcome: Bounded provenance-bound discoveries are classified as adjacent backlog, correctness/security blocker, or inert amendment recommendation without widening scope or mutating topology.
discovered-work-quarantine.primary_invariant: Discovery can never widen an attempt, enqueue work, alter dependencies or priorities, or mutate approved topology; blocker records escalate only through the governed failure path.
discovered-work-quarantine.acceptance_oracle: Hostile Worker-result/redaction tests, no enqueue/dependency/priority mutation assertions, amendment-recommendation inertness absent renewed Gate 1, and blocker escalation through the governed failure lifecycle.
discovered-work-quarantine.production_seam: Worker result boundary and append-only Orchestration evidence/classification records.
discovered-work-quarantine.blast_radius: Worker result contract, discovery validation/redaction, Orchestration classification records, and focused tests.
non_goals: Decomposer invocation, partial re-decomposition, or executable amendment.
Gate 1 approval or probe evidence.

exceptions.cross_domain: A discovery attestation with no controller validation/persistence cannot be accepted safely; the bounded Worker-result boundary is the minimum seam.

queue-and-restart-recovery.observable_outcome: Every ordinary controller/queue/lease/result interruption reconciles idempotently without duplicate paid work, lost terminal state, stale authority, or omitted counters, budgets, or discoveries.
queue-and-restart-recovery.primary_invariant: SQLite-authoritative fenced state rejects stale, duplicate, or conflicting actors and terminal results and never infers success from partial state.
queue-and-restart-recovery.acceptance_oracle: Crash-window matrix for committed-attempt/missing-job, duplicate job/result, expired lease/stale result, and result authorization; stale lease/token/CAS tests; fail-closed unsafe migration/startup; owned-sandbox recovery; and reopen verification preserving IDs, counters, budget totals, and discovery evidence.
queue-and-restart-recovery.production_seam: Deterministic jobs, queue adapter, leases, SQLite lifecycle, startup reconciliation, and migrations.
queue-and-restart-recovery.blast_radius: Orchestration contracts/store/services, queue integration, sandbox cleanup recovery, migrations, and tests.
non_goals: Compose packaging, encrypted off-host backup, or empty-host restore.
Formal multi-host guarantees or transactional outbox/inbox.

exceptions.cross_domain: Owned-resource recovery consumes Agent Execution outcomes but Orchestration alone mutates lifecycle truth.
exceptions.multi_contract: Lease, queue, result, CAS, migration, and reconciliation contracts share terminal-state semantics.
exceptions.multi_suite: State-machine, persistence, queue, sandbox-recovery, and migration suites cover distinct interruption boundaries.

adr015-component-pr-assembly.observable_outcome: An accepted connected component is reverified at its composed head and materialized idempotently as exactly one provenance-bearing GitHub PR awaiting Gate 2.
adr015-component-pr-assembly.primary_invariant: Only reverified component commits with complete provenance enter trusted host-side delivery; no GitHub side effect occurs before successful re-verification, and stale/conflicting failures return to the governed failure lifecycle.
adr015-component-pr-assembly.acceptance_oracle: Deterministic component/grouping and provenance tests, integration re-verification tests proving changed suite hashes or red/missing evidence prevent PR creation/update with no GitHub side effect, GitHub-adapter contract tests for repository/ref/identity binding and idempotent branch/commit/PR effects, and a credential-canary test proving GitHub credentials occur only in the trusted host adapter.
adr015-component-pr-assembly.production_seam: Integration re-verification, ADR-015 PR assembly, and the trusted GitHub adapter.
adr015-component-pr-assembly.blast_radius: Integration and Delivery domain, orchestration delivery state, GitHub configuration/credentials, and tests.
non_goals: Gate-2 review authorization or comment processing.
ADR-037 planning PRs or ADR-038 node-level mainline integration.
Automatic deployment.

exceptions.cross_domain: Verification, Orchestration, and Delivery are inseparable for a governed reviewable GitHub outcome; the governed failure dependency makes the authoritative resolution boundary precede any privileged adapter use.
exceptions.multi_contract: Component manifest, commit provenance, verdict, and PR identities jointly prevent bypass and replay.
exceptions.multi_suite: Integration, delivery-adapter, and credential-isolation tests cover separate external boundaries.

github-gate2-governed-review.observable_outcome: Only an authorized signature-verified replay-protected human review record can complete or return an awaiting PR, while comments become bounded non-executable revision inputs.
github-gate2-governed-review.primary_invariant: No caller, Worker, comment, small-diff exception, or automation can force completion without the authorized review record; comment content can never cause command, dispatch, topology, Gate-2, or delivery-state effects.
github-gate2-governed-review.acceptance_oracle: Controlled approval/rejection PR lifecycle plus forged signature, replay, wrong repository/ref/identity, caller/Worker/automation bypass, and hostile signed-comment/prompt-injection inertness tests.
github-gate2-governed-review.production_seam: GitHub event adapter and delivery state transitions under Gate-2 authority.
github-gate2-governed-review.blast_radius: Integration and Delivery domain, webhook/event verification, revision-input records, and tests.
non_goals: PR assembly or integration re-verification.
Comment-driven execution or ADR-037 planning PRs.
ADR-038 merge-event dependency unlock semantics or target deployment.

exceptions.cross_domain: External GitHub events cross into trusted delivery state only through signature/replay verification owned by Integration and Delivery.
exceptions.multi_contract: Webhook, review-record, and revision-input contracts prevent bypass and execution.
exceptions.multi_suite: Event-verification and lifecycle suites cover separate authorization boundaries.

single-host-operations-baseline.observable_outcome: A private pre-release host can start, diagnose, restart, migrate, back up, empty-host restore, retain, and clean up the direct-task/CRAFTS/grading/recovery stack without credential leakage, delivery adapters, delivery credentials, or duplicate terminal effects.
single-host-operations-baseline.primary_invariant: Every operational effect is health-visible, least-privilege, durable, fenced, requires no delivery-owned capability or credential, and claims no functional delivery before the release-convergence node.
single-host-operations-baseline.acceptance_oracle: Pinned composition, health/status, credential canaries over the injected Z.ai/queue/encryption/backup secrets, restart windows, WAL-safe encrypted off-host backup/restore drill, migration rollback, retention, and owned-resource cleanup tests.
single-host-operations-baseline.production_seam: Single-host service composition and operational controls over already implemented application capabilities.
single-host-operations-baseline.blast_radius: Deployment definitions, service configuration, health/logging, backup/restore, migrations, retention, operator docs, and system tests.
non_goals: Public release claim or Gate-2 capability proof.
Trusted GitHub adapter startup, GitHub/delivery credential injection, or any delivery-host composition requirement (owned by functional-pool-release-convergence).
New business capability or workflow.
Multi-host/multi-tenant operation or formal SLO/on-call.

exceptions.cross_domain: Host composition exercises all previously accepted runtime domains without changing their policy or depending on the parallel delivery branch.
exceptions.multi_contract: Service health, secret, backup, restore, migration, and retention contracts jointly define recoverable operation.
exceptions.multi_suite: Composition, restart, backup/restore, credential-canary, and cleanup lanes establish different operational properties.

functional-pool-release-convergence.observable_outcome: The restored single-host release composes the trusted host-side GitHub adapter under least-privilege credential injection and credential canaries, then completes one controlled authenticated direct task through qualified GLM-5.2 routing, full CRAFTS, grading, ADR-015 PR assembly, mandatory Gate 2, and final GitHub disposition with traversable IDs and hashes.
functional-pool-release-convergence.primary_invariant: No live task is accepted as production-complete without the complete chain; GitHub credentials remain confined to the least-privilege trusted delivery adapter, and sealed Pool Proof and dogfood evidence remain unchanged.
functional-pool-release-convergence.acceptance_oracle: One retained end-to-end restored-host trace including trusted host-side GitHub adapter composition, least-privilege GitHub credential injection, and credential-canary checks, plus deterministic aggregate, Docker, retained-report, backup/restore, cleanup, and immutable Pool Proof checks with independent hash traversal.
functional-pool-release-convergence.production_seam: Release composition, including trusted host-side GitHub adapter composition and host credential injection, over accepted delivery and operations seams; no new policy seam.
functional-pool-release-convergence.blast_radius: Release composition, the trusted host-side GitHub adapter configuration and its least-privilege credentials, one controlled end-to-end run, retained trace evidence, and release verification lanes.
non_goals: New capability, probing, Gate 1, Graphify, or eval calibration.
ADR-037/038 or automatic target deployment.

exceptions.cross_domain: The release claim necessarily composes the delivery and operations branches, including the delivery-host GitHub adapter seam neither branch could verify alone, without reimplementing either.
exceptions.multi_contract: Reuses every prior node contract; the only new binding is the traversable release trace with the delivery-host composition contract.
exceptions.multi_suite: Deterministic, Docker, retained-evidence, backup/restore, real end-to-end, and credential-canary lanes establish different release properties.
